## What happened

Describe what you expected and what you observed.

## Reproduction

Include a minimal example and the steps to reproduce it. For protocol issues, share a minimal A2UI message sequence using synthetic data.

## Environment

For SDK issues, include the package revision, A2UI protocol version, catalog ID, .NET version, and any renderer or transport involved.
